title: I canceled my subscription today.
text: I just received my 3rd subscription box. It contained a movie moment of Luke Skywalker on Dagobah. There was no T-shirt or anything wearable in my previous 3 boxes. I'm not a fan of the movie moment I got this time. The characters you really want you might have already from this franchise in some form. The add ins like a note pad this time with a mini pop or toothpick holders"shot glasses" are cute but I do not feel like I am getting great value.
label: neutral
